items.quote: I will stand before thee there upon the rock in Horeb; and thou shalt smite the rock, and there shall come water out of it, that the people may drink
items.claim: God will stand on the rock in Horeb; Moses will strike it and water will emerge for the people to drink

items.quote: And Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel
items.claim: Moses performed this action (smote the rock) in the sight of the elders of Israel
